free.title: Snoopy in Style NYC - Last Chance
free.caption:
LAST CHANCE · SNOOPY IN STYLE NYC

Snoopy is a bigger fashion icon than most people in this city, and his free NYC pop-up wraps up this Saturday.

16,000 square feet in Meatpacking turned into three rooms of Peanuts history - Snoopy and Woodstock dressed head to toe by Coach, Sandy Liang, LUAR and Bode, a Joe Cool listening lounge stacked with real comic strips, and a mini print vending machine that's basically free-souvenir roulette.

No ticket, no app, just walk in 10am-6pm daily. Last entry is 5:30pm sharp on September 26, and after that it's gone for good.

Send this to your most Snoopy-coded friend before Saturday hits.

📷 amNY

food.title: Prince Street Pizza
food.caption:
FOOD · PRINCE STREET PIZZA

If you've seen one NYC pizza square all over your feed, it's probably this one - the Spicy Spring at Prince Street Pizza in SoHo.

It's a thick Sicilian square draped in fra diavolo sauce, fresh mozzarella and crisped pepperoni cups that curl up exactly the way they're supposed to. No reservations, barely any seats - you order at the counter and eat standing, and there's usually a line wrapped past the corner.

27 Prince St, steps from the 6 at Spring St or N/R/W at Prince St. Opens at 10am, and weekday late mornings are the only time you'll walk right up.

Tag the friend who still hasn't tried the square slice everyone keeps posting.

📷 Pexels

art.title: Please Don't Tell (PDT)
art.caption:
AFTER DARK · PLEASE DON'T TELL

The best speakeasy in the East Village doesn't have a sign, a door, or a normal entrance - you order a hot dog first.

Walk into Crif Dogs on St Marks Place, find the vintage wooden phone booth against the wall, pick up the receiver, and wait. If there's room, the back panel opens into Please Don't Tell - a tiny, low-lit cocktail bar running since 2007 that picked up a James Beard Award for its bar program in 2012.

113 St Marks Place, a few minutes from the 6 at Astor Pl or the L at 1 Av. Open nightly - walk-ins happen, but reserving ahead skips the wait once the booth line starts forming.

Save this for the next night you want to disappear for a few hours.

📷 Tripadvisor
